audit.why: 53.62% over 69 games. He owns level 1 and the crit-item late game, you own the 2-6 poke war. Content and full agree on that arc.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1] and phases[3] say to trade 'when Tryndamere's Undying Rage is down' at level 2 and levels 4-5. He has no ultimate then. phases[4].why writes 'Between the Worlds'.
audit.why: Before 6 the only cooldown worth tracking is Spinning Slash (E, 12s at rank 1 down to 8s, 650 range) — it is his single gap-closer and the whole poke war is about making it whiff. Undying Rage is 120s at rank 1 down to 80s, which is the number that actually matters after 6.
audit.corrected: Both phase lines re-keyed to Spinning Slash; the ultimate name fixed and its real cooldown given.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] treats Mocking Shout as an unconditional slow, and the entry never states that his healing is one 12-second cast.
audit.why: Mocking Shout (W, flat 14s, 850 range) reduces attack damage on everyone around him, but it only slows enemies whose BACKS are turned to him. Face him and you keep your move speed — that single rule is what lets you kite the spin, and the attack-damage cut is nearly worthless against an ability-power mage anyway. Bloodlust (Q, flat 12s) is his only heal and it consumes Fury, so Grievous Wounds landed before he casts it is what breaks the sustain loop.
audit.corrected: The facing rule and the 12s Bloodlust are now stated in wants.foe[1] and the cooldown block.

edits.after: Catch you with your back turned, because Mocking Shout (W) only slows you if you are facing away

notes: Mocking Shout only slows targets facing away from him — the entry treated it as an unconditional slow, which is the difference between kiting his spin and dying to it. The full layer keyed levels 2 and 4-5 to Undying Rage, which he does not have until 6. The four packet suspect names here ('Undying Rage's', 'Hold Across the Veil', 'Save Between Worlds', 'The Weirding's') are all FALSE POSITIVES — every one is the correct name plus a possessive or a leading verb.
